title: Quaintly Cheesy American Cheese Casserole
description: A sweet and savory American cheese casserole featuring red wine jelly and bhuna, cooked to perfection in a tagine pot, this dish is jain-friendly and perfect for a comforting dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the bhuna sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked macaroni, bhuna sauce mixture, and chopped American cheese.
Stir in the red wine jelly and season with salt and black pepper.
Transfer the macaroni mixture to a tagine pot or a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top the casserole with additional American cheese slices and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
